label: H.R. 5103
title: Make the District of Columbia Safe and Beautiful Act of 2025

items.snippet: This bill establishes a commission in the executive branch to advise on certain criminal and immigration matters in the District of Columbia (DC).
…facilitate the provision of federal resources to reduce crime, and assist with recruitment and retention of DC's Metropolitan Police Department officers.
Next, the bill directs the Department of the Interior to establish a program to coordinate and maintain the cleanliness of commonly visited areas in DC, including monuments, parks, and roads.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
